name: Biohotel Leutascher Hof
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Biohotel Leutascher Hof in Leutasch Nestled in the heart of the Tirol Alps, Biohotel Leutascher Hof invites you to experience pure relaxation and natural beauty in the…
beschreibung: The Biohotel Leutascher Hof in Leutasch offers an exceptional organic dining experience dedicated to sustainability and premium regional cuisine. The kitchen creates refined alpine dishes prepared exclusively with 100% certified organic ingredients from local organic farms. The warm wooden dining rooms provide an elegant yet cozy setting, perfect for indulging after exploring the scenic Leutasch valley. A premier organic restaurant in Tirol.
